instruction: A candid photographic medium full shot captures an outdoor narrow alleyway with stone steps. The man in the white suit (R2) wearing white angel wings on the left and the woman in the black dress (R1) wearing black angel wings on the right walk side-by-side down the stairs. They hold hands as they descend, with the man's left leg forward and the woman's right leg forward. Both face forward with neutral expressions. The background features warm-toned European buildings. The scene is illuminated by warm, natural daylight with soft shadows that enhance the warm color palette.
